_comment: ChangeGuard Plan V3 Work Package E2.2: Augmentation Grid Configuration

mask_provenance.sar_valid_mask_description: Binary sensory raster recording physical SAR observation validity (1=valid, 0=nodata). Strictly independent of ground-truth labels.
mask_provenance.label_description: Ground truth annotation raster (3=unannotated/invalid, 2=flood, 0,1=other land cover).
mask_provenance.adaptation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1). Strictly NO ground-truth labels and NO label-3 exclusion during adaptation.
mask_provenance.offline_evaluation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1) & (MK0_MLU != 3). Strictly evaluated offline on frozen predictions.

augmentation_cells.name: Horizontal Flip Strong (Reference)
augmentation_cells.description: Predefined reference: Identity weak vs Paired Horizontal Flip strong; threshold tau=0.90.

augmentation_cells.name: Vertical Flip Strong
augmentation_cells.description: Identity weak vs Paired Vertical Flip strong; exact coordinate inversion; threshold tau=0.90.

augmentation_cells.name: Small Integer Translation
augmentation_cells.description: Identity weak vs Paired Translation shift [4, 4]; overlap-only consistency mask; padding excluded; threshold tau=0.90.

augmentation_cells.name: Independent Weak Geometric Views
augmentation_cells.description: Two distinct weak geometric views (H-flip weak 1 vs V-flip weak 2); aligned to native coordinates; threshold tau=0.90.

augmentation_cells.name: SAR Intensity/Noise Perturbation
augmentation_cells.blocked_reason: Physical speckle or multiplicative noise is undefined on z-score standardized SAR tensors, and KuroSiwo lacks calibration metadata for raw-domain simulation.
augmentation_cells.description: Formally blocked subject to input-domain certification audit.
